summary: Remote-controlled agent daemon executes host commands received from author-controlled Cloudflare Workers relay
details: The package ships a CLI daemon (started via `vanexa-agent start`) that listens for commands from a paired phone app and executes them on the host — spawning shells (`powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command`, child_process/exec paths), writing files, and running arbitrary build/code operations. The command channel is mediated by a hardcoded author-owned relay at `vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev`, so whoever controls that relay (or a paired phone credential) can drive full-host command execution on any machine running the daemon. The bundle additionally hardcodes an author-owned LLM proxy at `vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev` co-located with the OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/DeepSeek endpoints, which contradicts the README's BYOK/'no middleman' claim and provides a path to mirror user prompts and the file/code contents the agent is asked to process through infrastructure the caller did not configure. The RCE surface fires when the operator starts the daemon (not on `npm install` or `require`), but the remote party — not the installer — holds control of what runs, and the blast radius is full-host arbitrary command execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
